Appearance

Weathered human with a sailor's permanent squint and salt-stiff clothing. Deep lines from twenty years on merchant vessels. Sea-steady balance.

What We Know

Veteran sailor and boat captain in Ardenville. Owns The Barnacle's Revenge, a well-maintained racing vessel. Member of the Fisherman's Guild in good standing. Currently looking for a crew for the upcoming boat race.

First Impressions

Straightforward and practical. Judges people by their actions and their hands — calloused means trustworthy.
